scenarios.name: setup-greenfield
scenarios.description: Setup scaffolds every context file, the index, and commits.
scenarios.prompt:
/conductor:conductor-setup

This is a new project: a dependency-free Python library that converts temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin. Use Autogenerate mode everywhere, the default workflow, and skip the optional agent skills.

scenarios.name: new-track-autogenerate
scenarios.description: New track drafts spec and plan, registers one track, and writes no code.
scenarios.prompt:
/conductor:conductor-new-track "Add c_to_f(celsius) to tempconv that returns Fahrenheit and raises TypeError for non-numeric input"

Use Autogenerate mode for the spec, no reference documents, and do not start implementing.

scenarios.name: new-track-recalls-learnings
scenarios.description: New track recalls an archived track's learnings and cites them in the spec.
scenarios.prompt:
/conductor:conductor-new-track "Add f_to_c(fahrenheit) to tempconv that returns Celsius and rejects invalid input"

Use Autogenerate mode for the spec, no reference documents, and do not start implementing.

scenarios.name: implement-verification-gate
scenarios.description: Implement completes the coding tasks with SHAs but never self-confirms the manual verification.

scenarios.name: revise-preserves-history
scenarios.description: Revise adds scope without rewriting completed tasks and records a revision.
scenarios.prompt: /conductor:conductor-revise celsius_20260101 "Also add k_to_c(kelvin) that rejects values below absolute zero with ValueError"

scenarios.name: status-read-only
scenarios.description: Status reports progress without modifying anything.
